snippet.title: WATCHMEN: THE END IS NIGH The Complete Experience Trailer
snippet.description: Find more news/entertainment/TV/DVD/Game coverage at www.ifmagazine.com. In this teaser trailer to the game WATCHMEN: THE END IS NIGH, you see some of the gameplay and playable characters as well as the combo pack you get along with the film.
